title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07
source: MR > DAT > CD > EAC > CDWAV > Cool Edit Pro Noise Filter > SHN > CDR (Except for * which is MR > DAT > CD)

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of an iconic November ’69 concert with a soaring Lovelight jam and a cosmic Dark Star/Uncle John’s Band segment, though some note the band sounding a bit too tight.
ai_review.review: The recording is a respectable sound‑board tape that delivers most of the show clearly, highlighted by an explosive ending jam on “Lovelight” and a jaw‑dropping UJB interlude inside “Dark Star.” While many fans rave about the performance’s energy, one reviewer feels the set shows a turn toward a more rehearsed, routinized feel, especially on “Mama Tried.”

ai_rating.rationale: Four of five reviews are strongly positive about the music and give decent marks to the recording; one negative review drags the average down, resulting in a solid but not outstanding overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe it as “not a bad recording” and note no major drop‑outs; one reviewer simply couldn’t comment on the tape, but overall the sound is clear enough to enjoy.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Uncle John's Band (UJB jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its powerful closing jam and a remarkable mid‑song UJB excursion inside Dark Star, giving the concert an exciting arc despite occasional feelings of over‑tightness.

band_member_comments.Bob: One reviewer points out Bob Weir spacing the second verse of “Mama Tried,” suggesting a more routinized, less spontaneous feel.
